final: WITH patient_avgs AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) as avg_pt, AVG(CAST(l.IGA AS REAL) - CAST(l.IGM AS REAL)) as avg_iga_igm_diff FROM Patient p INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_iga_igm_diff) as overall_mean_iga_igm FROM patient_avgs) SELECT pa.SEX, AVG(pa.avg_pt) as avg_pt_by_sex, AVG(pa.avg_iga_igm_diff) as avg_iga_igm_diff_by_sex, AVG(pa.avg_iga_igm_diff / om.overall_mean_iga_igm) as avg_ratio_to_mean_by_sex FROM patient_avgs pa CROSS JOIN overall_mean om GROUP BY pa.SEX ORDER BY pa.SEX
